liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Listener describes the performance as a cosmic voyage through Saturn's rings and outer planets; Only Dark Star and Saint Stephen from this show appear on the Live/Dead album [11][13][20][21]
- **The Eleven** (3 reviews): The Eleven and Lovelight on Live/Dead originate from the January 26, 1969 show; Live/Dead versions of The Eleven and Lovelight come from the Avalon Ballroom show on January 26, 1969 [14][16][19]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): The opening sequence including Cryptical Envelopment appears as the first track on Disc 2 of So Many Roads [18]

## The recordings

- **gd69-02-27.sbd.16track.kaplan.6315.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 15 songs; 119 min; rated 4.69/5 by 32 [1]
- **gd1969-02-27.sbd.orp.58.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 119 min; rated 1.43/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: Flaw notes identify a small dropout during Cryptical and a reel cut during The Eleven [3]
- **gd1969-02-27.153340.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 3 songs; 41 min [5]
- **gd1969-02-27.153331.aud.martin.flac16**: audience recording; 3 songs; 36 min [7]. Said about its sound: Martin's version matches circulating soundboards and the release at the 37-second mark of the song [7]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- Show is strikingly similar to the Grateful Dead performance from Fillmore East on February 11, 1969 [12]
- Considered one of the band's best 1969 shows, alongside the New Year's Eve performance [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-02-27.sbd.16track.kaplan.6315.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Audio lineage includes 16-track master reel, rough mix DAT, and digital transfers via Kaplan [1]
- **gd1969-02-27.sbd.orp.58.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Orp; source: SBD reels > PCM > DAT > CD-R [3]
- **gd1969-02-27.153340.mtx.tobin.flac16**: taped by Steve Martin; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [5]. Also: FLAC conversion performed on September 13, 2021, by archive.org user Trader Little Helper [5]
- **gd1969-02-27.153331.aud.martin.flac16**: transferred by Steve Martin and Kevin Tobin; source: Aud Master > ??? > Latvala's Reel @3 3/4 ips Mastered to CDR by Steve Martin: "I transfered Dicks reel on a revox A77 onto a Sony F2 PCM unit. My Beta Pcm I… [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Worthpoint: [GRATEFUL DEAD 1969 FILLMORE WEST 3rd PRINTING CONCERT POSTER / NM 2 MINT | #4667184697](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-1969-fillmore-west-3rd-4667184697) [23]
